nodes.label: libpq Client
nodes.desc: Client library that opens the connection and sends the startup packet.

nodes.label: Postmaster
nodes.desc: Listens for clients and forks a fresh backend process per connection.

nodes.label: Backend Process
nodes.desc: Per-connection server loop that reads, plans, and runs each statement.

nodes.label: Parser
nodes.desc: Converts raw SQL text into a raw parse tree.

nodes.label: Parse Analysis
nodes.desc: Turns the parse tree into a semantically checked Query tree.

nodes.label: Rewriter
nodes.desc: Applies views, rules, and row-security policies to the Query tree.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.desc: Searches candidate plans and emits a PlannedStmt for the executor.

nodes.label: Executor
nodes.desc: Drives the plan tree and produces result tuples.

nodes.label: Buffer Manager
nodes.desc: Shared buffer pool that caches table and index pages in memory.

nodes.label: Heap Access
nodes.desc: Reads and writes heap tuples with MVCC visibility semantics.

nodes.label: WAL Insert
nodes.desc: Logs every modification into the write-ahead log before pages flush.

nodes.label: WAL Recovery
nodes.desc: Replays the log at startup to restore a consistent database state.
